description: This file defines the AccountService class responsible for user account management, including registration, login, verification, password reset, and invitation handling within a multi-platform environment (open-source, cloud, enterprise). It interacts with various services and entities related to users, organizations, workspaces, roles, and sessions.

classes.name: AccountService
classes.description: Service class managing user accounts, including registration, login, verification, password management, and invitations, supporting multiple platforms and integrating with various related services and entities.

methods.name: resendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Resends account verification email with a new token and expiry.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies user account using a temporary token.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by sending a reset email.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user password after validating token and expiry.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and retrieves workspace details.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration across different platforms.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Sends an invitation to a user to join a workspace or organization.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and records the activity.
